description: identity-obj-proxy 3 as a CSS module mapper (T11.11): `moduleNameMapper: { "\\.css$": "identity-obj-proxy" }`, on two files under one worker. `require('./a.css').foo` reads back `foo`, and under `jestEsm` `import styles from './a.css'` goes through Babel's interop over the proxy's `__esModule: false`, so the default import is the proxy itself and `styles.foo` is `foo` too, while a named import beside it reads `undefined` (`_interopRequireWildcard` copies the proxy's own keys, of which it has none). Read by `provino`'s `ecosystem-matchers.test.ts`.
